title: VITAL: Visual-Semantic Dual Supervision for Enhanced and Interpretable Latent Reasoning in Medical MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.28422v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Latent reasoning enables reasoning over continuous hidden states rather than explicit tokens, avoiding the language bottleneck and inference overhead of chain-of-thought for medical VQA. However, existing methods suffer from modality collapse, insufficient visual supervision, and train-inference mismatch. Moreover, their opaque latent states offer no interpretability, which is critical in clinical applications. We propose VITAL, a latent-space reasoning framework for medical MLLMs with visual-semantic dual supervision: an auxiliary text decoder reconstructs reasoning chains from latent states, while a visual projector regresses ROI features from a frozen, independent medical vision encoder. Both modules are discarded at inference with zero overhead, yet can be re-attached post-hoc for dual interpretability, providing textual and visual explanations of the reasoning process without sacrificing efficiency. We construct a 61K data

translated_title: VITAL：基于视觉-语义双重监督的医学多模态大语言模型增强可解释潜在推理方法
translated_abstract: 潜在推理使模型能够基于连续的隐状态而非显式token进行推理，从而避免了医学视觉问答中思维链的语言瓶颈与推理开销。然而，现有方法存在模态坍缩、视觉监督不足以及训练-推理不匹配等问题。此外，其不透明的隐状态缺乏可解释性，而这在临床应用中至关重要。我们提出VITAL，一种具有视觉-语义双重监督的医学多模态大语言模型潜在空间推理框架：一个辅助文本解码器从隐状态中重建推理链，同时一个视觉投影器从冻结的、独立的医学视觉编码器中回归ROI特征。这两个模块在推理时被丢弃，实现零开销，但可在事后重新附加以提供双重可解释性，在不牺牲效率的前提下为推理过程提供文本与视觉两种解释。我们构建了一个61K规模的数据……
tldr: VITAL提出了一种带视觉-语义双重监督的医学多模态大语言模型潜在空间推理框架，通过辅助文本解码器与视觉投影器在推理时零开销地实现推理过程的文本与视觉双重可解释性。
en_tdlr: VITAL introduces a latent-space reasoning framework for medical MLLMs with visual-semantic dual supervision, achieving zero-overhead dual interpretability (textual and visual) of the reasoning process via an auxiliary text decoder and a visual projector.
